title: Archive through July 15, 2002 - Anonymous (Monday, May 27, 2002 - 06:37 pm)
content: I came into a dark room with very few details - a person - unknown to me approached me and told me in a low voice - I am not sure I even heard a voice - to watch carefully and with deep graveness – Then he showed me an open coffin with a skeleton in it - I think the woodwork was dark - it took a while, none spoke - then it seemed as if the bottom started flowing or something - almost as if it were made of quicksilver - and the bottom of the coffin was raised and lifted in front of me and it became a mirror in which I saw myself standing in front of an large number of people - I couldn’t recognize any - different ages but no faces - it seemed as if they were in dark clothes. In that moment I had the impression of total knowledge, deep insight, extreme inner calmness and loss of fear for anything. I cannot quite put words on this, but it was a sort of up-lifting feeling. Then the mirror became more enlightened - as if you turn a mirror up the sun and the reflections hit your eyes - then this great white light surrounded me... This was the very first thing I remembered when I woke up after the operation - when I close my eyes this experience is as clear to me as the breakfast I have just ate or as typing this. I am a pretty realistic person - I have never experienced anything like this - and I have always considered "believers" to be not in their right mind, crack pots all and every one... However this has made me reconsider - I am another person today. I learned after the operation, that it was very, very close that I had died - with an extremely low pressure, and a heart not working. After I was released from hospital I received phone calls from doctors in the hospital to have further examinations - they were rather concerned about my conditions. I have since spoken with other people from the operating thatres/anesthetics - whom I know personally - and have learned that they thought they had lost me that day.

arrival.other_being_detail: An unknown person approached and instructed the experiencer to watch carefully.

environment.environment_other_detail: Dark room; open coffin with skeleton; coffin bottom became mirror; later a great white light surrounded the experiencer.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Vision-like scene: dark room; unknown person instructs to watch; coffin with skeleton; coffin bottom becomes mirror showing self before many faceless people; then great white light surrounds experiencer.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/boundary described; experience begins in a dark room with an unknown guide and symbolic imagery, then transitions to a surrounding white light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Open coffin with a skeleton; coffin bottom flows like quicksilver and rises to become a mirror showing the experiencer before many faceless people in dark clothes.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “In that moment I had the impression of total knowledge, deep insight, extreme inner calmness and loss of fear for anything.”
